name: Life-help · working identity
description: Practical life skills. Public name to be chosen by the administrator.

config.mission: Make everyday life easier with useful, accurate, saveable guidance.
config.audience: People building everyday household and adulting skills

editorial.description: Practical, clear, calm, smart without sounding academic, conversational without forced trends. Specific over motivational. No shame, lecturing, filler, exaggerated promises, or fake guru language. Useful enough to save. Temporary working voice.
editorial.reading_style: Plain language for a busy reader on a phone
hook_styles: Small action with a clear payoff
editorial.cta_style: A natural suggestion to save or try one action, only when it adds value
editorial.formatting_preferences: Strong short action headlines, 1-3 short lines of explanation, practical examples only when supported

moderation_rules: Escalate consequential financial, medical and legal advice
